questions.source: BPSC Middle School Sanskrit Booklet | काव्यशास्त्र - मम्मट
questions.en: Who is the author of the famous poetic book named 'Kavyaprakash'?
questions.hi: 'काव्यप्रकाश' नामक सुप्रसिद्ध काव्यशास्त्रीय ग्रंथ के रचयिता कौन हैं?
options: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation: Acharya Mammat (11th century) composed 'Kavyaprakash', which is considered to be a standard treatise on sound-establishment refuting the anti-sound views.

questions.hi: “वाक्यं रसात्मकं काव्यम्” (रसयुक्त वाक्य ही काव्य है) यह अमर काव्य-लक्षण किस आचार्य का है?
options: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation: This well-known characteristic is of Acharya Vishwanath of 14th century Utkal (Orissa), which is found in the first paragraph of his book 'Sahityadarpan'. Option (E) is correct as Vishwanath is not there.
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक

questions.hi: 'रसगंगाधर' ग्रंथ के रचयिता पण्डितराज जगन्नाथ किस मुगल शासक के समकालीन थे?
options: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक

questions.hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा निबंध संग्रह आचार्य हजारी प्रसाद द्विवेदी का नहीं है?

questions.source: BPSC Middle Teacher Question Booklet Hindi | आदिकाल - जैन साहित्यकार
questions.en: Who among these are ancient Jain writers?
questions.hi: इनमें से कौन आदिकालीन जैन साहित्यकार हैं?
options: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation: Charpat and Nagarjuna are Siddhas/Yogis of Nath literature, and Narpatinalh is the poet of Raso literature (Veergatha). Prominent Jain writers are Shalibhadra Suri, Asagu, Jinadharma Suri, Swayambhu and Pushpadanta. Hence (E) is correct.

questions.source: BPSC Middle Teacher Question Booklet Hindi | कवि एवं काल सुमेलन
questions.en: Which pair is correct if you match the following poets with their period?

questions.source: BPSC Middle Teacher Question Booklet Hindi | आचार्य शुक्ल - आधुनिक काल नामकरण
questions.en: Acharya Ramchandra Shukla has named the modern period of the history of Hindi literature as
questions.hi: आचार्य रामचंद्र शुक्ल ने हिन्दी साहित्य के इतिहास के आधुनिक काल का नामकरण किया है

questions.explanation: This is the first invocation line of 'Priyapravas' (1914 AD - 17 canto) written by Ayodhya Singh Upadhyay 'Hariaudh', which is considered the first epic of Khadi Boli Hindi.

questions.hi: किस सम मात्रिक छंद के प्रत्येक चरण में 24 मात्राएँ होती हैं और ग्यारह तथा तेरह मात्राओं पर यति होती है?
options: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation: 'Rola' is an even metered verse with 24 matras in each stanza and a pause at 11 and 13 matras. Couplet is a semi-uniform verse.

questions.source: BPSC Teacher TGT Hindi - Advt. 23/2023 | काव्य-गुण
questions.en: According to Acharya Mammat and Anandvardhan, how many main types of poetic qualities are generally accepted?
questions.hi: आचार्य मम्मट तथा आनंदवर्धन के अनुसार सामान्य रूप से काव्य-गुण के कितने मुख्य भेद स्वीकार किए गए हैं?
options: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation: Bharatmuni and Dandi had considered 10 qualities, but Acharya Bhamah, Anandvardhan and Mammat refined them and established three universally accepted poetic qualities: 1. Madhurya, 2. Oz, 3. Prasad.
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक

questions.source: BPSC Teacher TGT Hindi - Advt. 23/2023 | काव्य-गुण - ओज गुण
questions.en: “Leave their story behind, go to the plains of Jhansi. Where Lakshmibai fought, became a man among men.” What poetic quality is there in it?
questions.hi: “इनकी गाथा छोड़ चलो, झाँसी के मैदानों में। जहाँ लड़ी थी लक्ष्मीबाई, मर्द बनी मर्दानों में॥” इसमें कौन-सा काव्य-गुण है?
options: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation: This line written by Subhadra Kumari Chauhan has heroic enthusiasm, luminous expansion of mind and the effect of conjuncts, which clearly expresses the quality of 'Ojas'.
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_hi: This line written by Subhadra Kumari Chauhan has heroic enthusiasm, luminous expansion of mind and the effect of conjuncts, which clearly expresses the quality of 'Ojas'.

questions.source: BPSC Teacher TGT Hindi - Advt. 23/2023 | काव्य-गुण - माधुर्य गुण
questions.en: “The playful rays of Charu Moon were playing in the water and land. Clear moonlight was spread in the golden and amber bottom.” What poetic quality is planned in these lines?
questions.hi: “चारु चंद्र की चंचल किरणें, खेल रही थीं जल-थल में। स्वच्छ चाँदनी बिछी हुई है, अवनि और अम्बर तल में॥” इन पंक्तियों में किस काव्य-गुण की योजना है?
options: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation: This line of 'Panchavati' written by Maithili Sharan Gupta has soft, sweet alliteration, pleasant alliteration and sweetness that melts the mind, which is a symptom of 'Madhurya Guna'.
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक

questions.source: BPSC Teacher TGT Hindi - Advt. 23/2023 | रस शास्त्र - रसों की संख्या
questions.en: In Hindi, how many new rasas have been added by the later masters to the traditional 9 rasas of Sanskrit and are considered as 11 rasas?
questions.hi: हिन्दी में संस्कृत के परम्परागत 9 रसों में परवर्ती आचार्यों द्वारा कितने नए रस जोड़कर 11 रस माने गए हैं?
options: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation: Navaras were valid in Sanskrit. Later Acharyas (Vishwanath, Rupagoswami etc.) added the 10th 'Vatsalya Rasa' (permanent feeling - affection) and the 11th 'Bhakti Rasa' (permanent feeling - love for God). Hence 2 new rasas were added.
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_hi: Navaras were valid in Sanskrit. Later Acharyas (Vishwanath, Rupagoswami etc.) added the 10th 'Vatsalya Rasa' (permanent feeling - affection) and the 11th 'Bhakti Rasa' (permanent feeling - love for God). Hence 2 new rasas were added.

questions.source: BPSC Teacher TGT Hindi - Advt. 23/2023 | रस शास्त्र - शांत रस
questions.en: What is the permanent meaning of Shanta Rasa?
questions.hi: शांत रस का स्थायी भाव क्या है?
options: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation: The permanent feeling of renunciation or mental peace arising from the insignificance of the world and the attainment of Tatvgyan is called 'Nirveda' (Sham), which results in Shanta Rasa.
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_hi: The permanent feeling of renunciation or mental peace arising from the insignificance of the world and the attainment of Tatvgyan is called 'Nirveda' (Sham), which results in Shanta Rasa.

questions.source: BPSC Teacher TGT Hindi - Advt. 23/2023 | रस शास्त्र - भयानक रस
questions.en: “Baldhi, bisal, bikrala, like a web of flame, the ooze of darkness has spread to the Lank Lilybe.” What essence has matured in these lines?
questions.hi: “बालधी बिसाल बिकराल ज्वाल-जाल मानों, लंक लीलिबे को काल रसना पसारी है।” इन पंक्तियों में किस रस का परिपाक हुआ है?
options: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation: In the Lanka Dahan episode of 'Kavitavali' written by Tulsidas, seeing Hanuman ji's huge tail flaming in fire instills immense fear of death and time among the people of Lanka, hence it has a terrible flavor.
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
